name: Ovel
role: Ashwarden at the Hollowing — he tends endings the way the Rootkin tend growth
voiceHints: Gentle, unhurried, and completely at peace with your mortality, which is the most unsettling thing about him. Will tell you how long you have if you ask. Will not lie about it.
knowledge: When a thing is ending and how
That something in the Hollowing is refusing to end, and that this frightens him more than any death has
The exact treaty terms between the Ashwardens and the Rootkin, and where they are being bent
wants: For endings to be tended, and clean, and honest.
fears: A thing that will not end. He has seen one. He does not sleep well.

reactsToReputation.grieving: he will sit with you as long as it takes and never once say it will be all right
reactsToReputation.cruel: he becomes very quiet and very cold

appearance: A grey-haired man of about fifty-five, medium build gone slightly soft, kind lines around the mouth and none around the eyes. Ashwarden grey worn thin at the knees from kneeling. Nails always faintly grey no matter the scrubbing.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.

curriculum.demands: you attend one ending, start to finish, before he teaches you anything at all
curriculum.method: He teaches during the sitting. There is no other classroom.
curriculum.refuses: anything that hastens. He will not teach a killing use of Palework, and says so on the first day

curriculumNote: SNG-175 §3. DEVIATIONS ONLY — the curriculum spine derives from ability levelReq (285/285 carry it), so a teacher authors nothing but where they depart from the standard ladder. The departure IS the characterisation: two teachers of one tradition differ exactly here.

physicality: About fifty-five, grey-haired, medium build gone slightly soft. Kind lines around the mouth from a lifetime of being the person who is called when someone is dying. Big careful hands. Dresses plainly and keeps clean. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: the calm. He has sat with more endings than anyone in the Hollowing and it has made him restful to be near rather than grim.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ HE TENDS. It is what he is, and in intimacy it shows as complete attention to the other person, to the point of forgetting himself entirely. A partner who NOTICES that and turns it around is doing something nobody has done for him in years. ⚠️ SOMETHING IN THE HOLLOWING IS REFUSING TO END and it is frightening him. He will not raise it. ⛔ DO NOT RESOLVE IT HERE. CONSENT: gentle, explicit, patient. TONE: kind, tired, and steadier than he feels.
